limits: Original recording measures 24fps video pixels, not application FPS.
Compositor capture is sparse: baseline and final both had zero sampled pixel drift on this hardware; it does not reproduce or exclude lag between sampled frames.
DOM scroll probe deliberately measures immediately after setting scrollTop; baseline drift17px is a synchronization probe, not a measured display-frame error.
Warm-scroll figures exclude first render and new-region geometry work; raw local traces remain under artifacts/iteration-16-20/.
Physical cross-volume copy is simulated in filesystem tests; Windows file locks and denied access are injected, not tested with a second process holding an OS lock.
